en.comment: at some point, this file should become empty and unnecessary.

event_deaths.one: This past moon, m_c has passed on. The b1_t mourns {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} loss, and {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} friends and neighbours will miss where {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} had been in their lives. Moments of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} life are shared in stories around the circle of mourners as those that were closest to {PRONOUN/m_c/object} take {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} final resting place.
event_deaths.many: The past moon, %{insert} have passed on. The b1_t mourns their loss, and their friends and neighbours will miss where they had been in their lives. Moments of their lives are shared in stories around the circle of mourners as those that were closest to them take them to their final resting place.

event_shaken_grief.one: So much grief and death has taken its toll on the cats of the b1_t. %{insert} is particularly shaken by it.
event_shaken_grief.many: So much grief and death has taken its toll on the cats of the b1_t. %{insert} are particularly shaken by it.

en.lead_den_killed: m_c was killed by baron1's Clippers.
en.condition_retire_adolescent: m_c decides {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}'d rather spend {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} time helping around camp and entertaining the kits; {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} warmly welcomed into the elders' den.
en.condition_retire_adolescent_ceremony: {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/are/is} celebrated for {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} contributions to the Barony.
en.condition_retire_no_baron: m_c has decided to retire from normal duty.
en.condition_retire_normal: Seeing m_c struggling the last few moons, lead_name approaches {PRONOUN/m_c/object} and promises that no one would think less of {PRONOUN/m_c/object} for retiring early, and that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} would still be a valuable member of the Barony. m_c agrees; later that day, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} officially {VERB/m_c/retire/retires}.
en.ceremony_baron_bloodthirsty: %{oldname} has become the new Baron of the b1_t. {PRONOUN/lead_name/subject/CAP} {VERB/lead_name/stare/stares} down at {PRONOUN/lead_name/poss} cats with unsheathed claws, promising a new era for the Badlands.
en.ceremony_baron_1: %{oldname} has been promoted to the new Baron of the b1_t. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/address/addresses} {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} cats with a quick speech before retiring to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} den to get to work.
en.ceremony_baron_2: %{oldname} has become the new Baron of the b1_t. {PRONOUN/lead_name/subject/CAP} {VERB/lead_name/vow/vows} to protect {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} cats, even at the cost of {PRONOUN/lead_name/poss} life.
en.ceremony_baron_3: %{oldname} has become the new Baron of the b1_t. {PRONOUN/lead_name/subject/CAP} {VERB/lead_name/feel/feels} like {PRONOUN/lead_name/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is}n't ready for this new responsibility, but will try {PRONOUN/lead_name/poss} best to do what is right for the cats under {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} care.
en.new_baron_from_heir: m_c has resumed the throne of the b1_t.
en.new_baron_from_heir_young: There's not a single Baron in the Badlands that agrees making a cat so young the b1_t's Baron is a good idea. However, m_c was r_c's heir, and no cat would dare disrespect that decision. m_c steps up as the new Baron of the b1_t.
en.new_baron_from_heir_child: Though somewhat occupied with {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} grief for r_c, m_c steps up to resume the throne of the b1_t.
en.new_baron_from_mate: Not only has m_c's mate just passed on, but r_c hasn't chosen an heir. Though buried deep in grief, m_c steps up as the b1_t's new Baron.
en.new_baron_from_mate_young: Not only has m_c's mate just passed on, but r_c hadn't chosen an heir. Though buried deep in grief, m_c steps up as the b1_t's new Baron, dissuading the murmurs from the Clippers that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} much too young for the responsibility.
en.new_baron_from_regent: Though {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/don't/doesn't} feel fully qualified, the b1_t cannot be left without a Baron. m_c steps up from {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} role of Regent to resume the throne.
en.new_baron_from_regent_young: m_c can hardly believe this is happening. To be made Regent so young, and now to be the only option left to step up as Baron? It's highly unusual, but {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/have/has} no choice-- {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/step/steps} up as the b1_t's new Baron.
en.new_baron_from_regent_child: m_c will always miss serving as Regent under their parent. Now, with no proper heir to resume the throne, m_c hopes r_c would approve of {PRONOUN/m_c/object} stepping up.
en.ceremony_regent_bloodthirsty: m_c has been chosen as the new Regent. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/look/looks} at {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clippers with an odd glint in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes.
en.ceremony_regent: lead_name chooses m_c as {PRONOUN/lead_name/poss} new Regent. %{previous}
en.ceremony_regent_prev2: {PRONOUN/lead_name/subject/CAP} {VERB/lead_name/don't/doesn't} know if dep_name would approve, but life must go on.
en.ceremony_regent_nolead_nodep: Without a Baron or Regent, the b1_t has been directionless. They all turn to m_c with hope for the future.
en.ceremony_regent_nolead_retireddep: The b1_t is without a Baron, but a new Regent must still be named. m_c is chosen as the new Regent. The retired Regent nods {PRONOUN/dep_name/poss} approval.
en.ceremony_regent_lead_retireddep0: m_c has been chosen as the new Regent. The cats yowl {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} name in approval.
en.ceremony_regent_lead_retireddep1: m_c has been chosen as the new Regent. Some of the older cats question the wisdom of this choice.
en.ceremony_regent_lead_retireddep2: m_c has been chosen as the new Regent. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/hold/holds} {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head up high and {VERB/m_c/promise/promises} to do {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} best for the b1_t.
en.ceremony_regent_lead_retireddep3: lead_name has been thinking deeply all day about who {PRONOUN/lead_name/subject} would trust and respect enough to lead {PRONOUN/lead_name/poss} Clippers. At sunhigh, {PRONOUN/lead_name/subject} {VERB/lead_name/make/makes} the announcement that m_c will be the b1_t's new Regent.
en.ceremony_regent_lead_retireddep4: m_c has been chosen as the new Regent. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/pray/prays} that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} the right choice.
en.ceremony_regent_lead_retireddep5: m_c has been chosen as the new Regent. Although {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} nervous, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/put/puts} on a brave face and {VERB/m_c/look/looks} forward to leading the Clippers.
en.ceremony_regent_unsuitable: No cat is truly fit to be Regent, but the position can't remain vacant. m_c is appointed as the new Regent.
en.ceremony_regent_none: There are no cats fit to become Regent.
en.ceremony_heir: lead_name chooses m_c as {PRONOUN/lead_name/poss} new heir. %{previous}
en.ceremony_heir_unsuitable: With no kits to bestow the title to, m_c has been chosen as lead_name's heir.
en.ceremony_heir_none: There are no cats suitable to be heir.
en.ceremony_heir_too_young: lead_name considers m_c for the role of heir once {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} old enough.

en.event_lost1: After a long journey, m_c has finally returned home.
en.event_lost2: m_c was found at the border, tired but happy to be home.
en.event_lost3: m_c strides into camp, much to the everyone's surprise. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} home!
en.event_lost4: {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} met so many friends on {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} journey, but the Badlands is where m_c truly belongs. With a tearful goodbye, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/return/returns} home.
